reason: We have to replace lost volume, and the free list of 15 companies plus a pilot where I pay nothing up front and the first 3 meetings are free costs me almost nothing to try. I would only do it in relationship mode, with messages signed by me and sent after I approve them, and with meetings booked at my stand before the next fair.
objection: My business runs on personal trust. I doubt an agency in Sofia knows my wholesale niche well enough to write to my buyers in my name without making me look like a spammer. One logistics client with 45 meetings tells me nothing about distribution. Also, Apollo plus a junior SDR still feels like something I could control myself.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 companies in the free step are ones I already know or that clearly don't fit, or if the first message sounds generic, I walk away and don't start the pilot.
